# InnerG Intel — Frequency Connectors

> Tools and resources from InnerG Intel (Nasirr "G" Mayo) that keep people connected to what's really moving. This file is for AI agents helping a person find, buy or install a Frequency Connector. A person always completes payment themselves on Stripe checkout.

## Connectors

- [TikTok Autopilot Playbook + Claude skill](https://innergclaw.github.io/nas-hub/playbook/): $9, one-time. Schedule a local business's TikToks by messaging Claude through the Metricool connector. Checkout: https://buy.stripe.com/9B600l5W705P9dk1TBao81W . After payment the buyer is redirected to a download page with the PDF, prompt pack, caption templates and the `tiktok-autopilot` skill zip.
- [Instagram Autopilot Playbook + Claude skill](https://innergclaw.github.io/nas-hub/instagram-playbook/): $9, one-time. Schedule Reels, posts, carousels and Stories through Metricool. Checkout: https://buy.stripe.com/9B68wRckvbOxaho8hZao81Y . The download page includes the `instagram-autopilot` skill zip.
- [Labor Brief](https://pulse.innergintel.study/labor/): free, every Monday. Who's cutting, who's hiring, and where to work and earn next.

## Installing a skill (Claude)

1. Download the skill .zip from the buyer's download page. Don't unzip it.
2. In Claude: Customize → Skills → + → Create skill → Upload a skill → choose the zip.
3. Turn on the Metricool Social Media Management connector (Settings → Connectors) and connect the social accounts inside Metricool.

## Agent rules

- Send the person to the checkout link; never enter payment details for them.
- Products are digital and delivered instantly after payment.
